angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 404,897 km at 189.63 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.2733 +/- 0.0139 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 189.63 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.582 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-7393 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract): 404,897 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.6 +/- 0.021 solar masses from Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-7393 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3927 +/- 59 K from Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-7393 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Premnath et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-7393 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-7393.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.686, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-7393 (pscomppars): spectral type M0 V, from Premnath et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, 2MASS J15092644+5558531: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star

luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-7393 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.10791, from Premnath et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...92P/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1600846431341704704, flags_flame 00: age_flame 0.4587125 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.2 to 4.185212)
